_readme: Crop plan for the three approved photos in assets/source/. Crops are fractions of the source image (x, y, w, h from the top left). 'aspect' (width:height) trims the crop to that shape, centred on 'focusY'. Entries with 'requiresCrop': true are refused until a real crop is entered and 'cropChecked' is true, so the banner on clinic-eyechart-wall.jpg can never ship by accident. Photos not listed here are converted whole. Files in assets/held/ are never read.

outputs.name: hero
outputs.note: Desktop hero background. Left third is the pale fade for text.

outputs.name: hero-m
outputs.note: Mobile strip above the H1: right two-thirds at 16:10. Check the crop by eye.

outputs.name: eyechart
outputs.note: MUST remove the left-hand banner (stand with 'Slow down myopia progression' and a percentage). Enter a crop x,y,w,h that excludes it, or paint it out first. Keep the eye chart wall and the EYE Q sign. Set cropChecked to true only after opening the output and confirming no text or figure from the banner is legible.

outputs.name: slit-lamp
outputs.note: Right half: slit lamp equipment and hands only. Open the output and confirm no face is visible.
